title: Independent re-analysis of public visual fPET time courses reproduces an early FDG rise, but does not independently reject the fastest published phosphorylation-only kinetics
abstract: We independently re-analysed the CC0-derived visual-cortex time-activity curves supplied with a published functional FDG-PET report (OpenNeuro ds003382), without executing its code. A new REF+WM baseline and flexible 2-min onset-basis model gave E(4)/E(10)=0.533 (participant bootstrap 95% CI 0.444-0.760; n=9). This reproduces the descriptive early rise. However, an independently derived first-order phosphorylation-only response spans 0.569-0.735 at the target's stated turnover range 0.14-0.30/min. The estimate is below the fastest-kinetics value but not above the slowest-kinetics value; hence our preregistered criterion for rejecting all stated phosphorylation-only kinetics was not met. This qualified independent replication supports the early-rise observation while leaving mechanism discrimination sensitive to kinetics and baseline/modeling choices.

citations.reason: Independent replication target; public derived inputs and scope were inspected, but its code was not executed.
